title: Improving Fairness of Large Language Models in Multi-document Summarization

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring summary-level Equal Coverage (EC) and corpus-level Coverage Parity (CP) using an entailment model to evaluate if positive, neutral, and negative product reviews are equally represented in generated summaries.

Evaluating Equal Coverage (EC) and Coverage Parity (CP) using an entailment model to assess whether left, center, and right political ideologies are fairly represented in multi-document summaries of tweets.

Calculating Equal Coverage (EC) and Coverage Parity (CP) using an entailment model to measure the balanced inclusion of 'support' and 'against' stances in summaries of tweets regarding specific target phrases.
